summary: Game Boy entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Game Boy Gallery

emulation.emulator: SameBoy, Gambatte, mGBA, or another accurate Super Game Boy-capable emulator
emulation.notes: Prefer an accurate Game Boy core from a legal PAL cartridge dump. Use DMG mode for the base handheld look or Super Game Boy mode for the officially compatible presentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Integer-scaled DMG or Super Game Boy-compatible capture from the original Game Boy release

primary.version: Original PAL Game Boy cartridge, optionally viewed in Super Game Boy-compatible mode
primary.why: Game Boy Gallery is an April 27, 1995 Game Boy release and is Super Game Boy compatible; there is no later platform reissue for this exact title. It is a Europe/Australia-only compilation, so the original Game Boy release is the complete primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PAL Game Boy cartridge in an accurate Game Boy emulator such as SameBoy, Gambatte, or mGBA. Capture with integer scaling and no smoothing; use Super Game Boy mode only if you want the supported border/color presentation rather than plain DMG grayscale.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or Virtual Console release exists for this exact title. Do not conflate it with later Game & Watch Gallery games; this compilation lacks the later series' original-mode option, Mario-character remakes, and battery-backed score saving.
